responsibility: Implements tree-SSA redundancy elimination built on value numbering, covering full redundancy elimination, partial redundancy elimination, and code hoisting. It initializes PRE expression/value tables, computes AVAIL and ANTIC sets with phi translation, inserts expressions to make partially redundant computations fully redundant, eliminates redundancies using RPO value numbering, performs cleanup of dead inserted code and tail merging, and coordinates with alias, SCEV, CFG, and SSA update machinery to leave the function in consistent optimized SSA form.
